# Add club events and calendar views

## Problem

The application lists recurring activity schedules but does not support one-off club events, event responses, or calendar views.

## Proposed outcome

Allow authorized staff to publish activity-related events and let students view event details and respond. Provide calendar-style views for upcoming events and sessions.

## Acceptance criteria

- Authorized staff can create, update, and cancel an event with a title, description, date/time, and associated activity or group.
- Students can view upcoming events and submit or update a response.
- Event responses are visible to authorized staff.
- Calendar views show dates and times clearly and work on mobile.
- The system clearly distinguishes events from recurring activity sessions.
- Calendar export (such as iCalendar) may be delivered as a follow-up if it is outside the initial scope.
